name: two-mode
facts: Every invocation picks its mode by reading ledger.md before doing anything else
Preflight mode runs when no engagement ledger exists, and is the only mode allowed to ask a question
Preflight covers §1 to §3: check security-audit is installed, offer to gitignore .audit/, create the engagement and state the cycle budget
Cycle mode runs while status is running, never asks a question, and delegates every heavy step to a cold agent
Cycle mode covers §4 and §5: spawn an agent that runs one audit, commit the run, continue or stop, then build and verify the report
The ledger's status moves from running to converged or max-cycles-reached, and then to done
